_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. An SRB2 project is the game, whose four pk3 files are the firmware, plus any add-ons and save data it wants.

slots.title: Add-ons
slots.help: Mods, levels and characters (.pk3, .wad, .soc, .lua), in the order they are loaded, as SRB2's -file option loads them. Leave this empty to play the game itself.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: The game progress to start from: gamedata.dat (unlocks, emblems and records) and save slots (srb2sav*.ssg), with those file names, as Export Save Data writes them. Leave this empty for a new game.
